landing.heroTitle1: Run your coaching in one place.

athlete.welcomeTitle: Manage all your trainings in one place!

coach.welcomeTitleMember: Focus on coaching. We'll handle the rest.
coach.welcomeSubtitleOwner: Confirmations, cancellations, and payments — on autopilot.
coach.welcomeSubtitleMember: Your school set you up. Here's what Sessio does for you day-to-day.
coach.goalTitle: What matters most to you right now?
coach.goalSubtitle: Pick one — you can use all of Sessio either way.
coach.goalOwnerOption1: Stop chasing people to confirm attendance
coach.goalOwnerOption2: Keep my groups full when someone drops out
coach.goalOwnerOption3: Track who paid and sessions remaining
coach.goalOwnerOption4: Oversee my whole school in one place
coach.goalMemberOption1: See my week across all my trainings
coach.goalMemberOption4: Message my athletes in one place
coach.benefitOwner1Desc: Athletes are enrolled by default. If they can't come, they cancel in one tap — you know instantly, no chasing.
coach.benefitOwner2Desc: When someone cancels, the spot goes to your waitlist. Groups stay full.
coach.benefitOwner3Desc: Know who's paid, who owes you, and how many sessions each athlete has left.
coach.benefitOwner4Title: One view of your whole school
coach.benefitOwner4Desc: All coaches, groups, and athletes in one dashboard.
coach.benefitMember1Title: One calendar for everything you teach
coach.benefitMember1Desc: Every group, every session, every student in one view.
coach.benefitMember2Desc: Athletes cancel in one tap — you see the list before every session.
coach.benefitMember3Desc: If someone drops out, the waitlist fills their spot. You just show up and coach.
coach.benefitMember4Desc: No more crossed wires in a mixed WhatsApp.
coach.pushTitle: Get told only when you need to act
coach.pushSubtitle: Sessio keeps quiet unless something actually needs you.
coach.pushOwnerBullet1: An athlete cancels and a spot opens up
coach.pushOwnerBullet2: Someone asks to join your training
coach.pushMemberBullet1: An athlete cancels before your session
